step6.title: Your Result
step6.ctaFreeNote: 15 minutes • Free • Personally with Poclaire Wamba & Team
step6.msgSalarie: As an employee, you have significant optimization potential — especially through professional expenses, commuter allowance and special deductions. Our team reviews your situation and maximizes your refund.
step6.msgFreelance: As a freelancer, smart structuring of your business expenses, proper income-expenditure accounting and VAT returns can generate substantial tax savings. We also handle your ongoing bookkeeping.
step6.msgGerant: As a company director, compensation optimization, shareholder loans and deductible business costs offer major tax leverage. We prepare your annual financial statements and ongoing accounting.
step6.msgRetraite: As a retiree, often overlooked deductions — medical costs, craftsman services and household services — can significantly reduce your tax. We review your pension assessment.
step6.msgDouble: With dual activity, tax coordination between both income sources is essential. We optimize your overall tax burden and handle your trade registration and income-expenditure accounting.
step6.msgBeamte: As a civil servant, you benefit from specific allowances, work expenses and special deductions. We know the specifics of civil servant compensation and pension taxation.
step6.msgEtudiant: As a student, you can often retroactively reclaim taxes — especially study costs, travel expenses and working student income. Losses are carryable.
step6.msgElternzeit: During parental leave, parental allowance can trigger the progression clause. We check if a tax return is worthwhile — often there are refunds.
step6.msgArbeitslos: Job seekers can deduct application costs, training and relocation expenses. We analyze your individual situation for refund potential.
step6.msgAutre: Every life situation has its tax specifics. We analyze your case individually to find the right solution for you.

footer.disclaimer: This is not tax advice within the meaning of § 4 StBerG. Binding advice exclusively by an independent tax adviser (Steuerberater).
